integrity: The result is proved symbolically from the hereditary property and Enomoto's published criterion. No finite experiment is used as evidence for an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional algebras over a field only; the proof that \(I_{\mathrm{ref}}(A)\) is full uses projective dimension at most one for nonprojective simples and does not extend verbatim to global dimension two.
title: Hereditary algebras are rigid under reflexive equivalence
